ryan: starting quiet-window rollout for route_split_alpha at 22:30 UTC. plan: 0% -> 1% -> 8% -> 40% with 10m gates. soft-pin model v6.1.0 for exposed traffic, fallback v6.0.4.
deploybot: scheduled job id 20240701-llmroute-88 for 2024-07-01T22:30:00Z. will emit events.
nina: rollback triggers: immediate drain to 0% if p95 +200ms OR 5xx delta > 1% sustained 4m. also abort on auto-eval fail.
oncall-bot: monitors set: latency_p95, 5xx_rate, token_quality_score. page on sev1 if p95 > 650ms or 5xx_rate > 2% for 3m. runbook: https://wiki/internal/rollouts#route_split_alpha
ops_jen: quick ops checklist:
```
- t+0 set route_split_alpha = 1%
- wait 10m, run smoke prompts, verify p95/5xx/quality
- keep soft-pin v6.1.0 for 8m after each bump
- use fast-disable: `releases flag set route_split_alpha 0 --immediate`
```
